pages.text: This is Melody Moo. She is a cute green monster. It is Easter morning! Melody Moo is very happy. She wears her yellow hard hat and her brown backpack.
Melody Moo looks at the table. There is a beautiful Easter card! The card is pink and white. It says, "Happy Easter, Melody Moo!"
Melody Moo is ready for an adventure. There is a big basket near the door. She takes the basket and goes outside to the garden.
In the garden, Melody Moo sees a friend. It is Binky the Easter bunny! Binky has long ears and a little nose. He is very fast.
Binky likes to play a game. He likes to hide things. Binky runs behind the trees and the bushes. He puts treats in the secret places.
Melody Moo looks for the treats. The garden is very pretty today. There are many red and purple flowers in the grass.
Melody Moo looks under a big leaf. There is a small, yellow chick! The chick says, "Cheep, cheep!" Melody Moo smiles at her new friend.
Look! There are six colorful Easter eggs near the tree! Melody Moo is so excited. She can jump very high! She puts the eggs in her basket.
Melody Moo takes her microphone and sings a song. She loves Easter! It is a wonderful day with friends and treats. Happy Easter!
